subject.why: Clearly shows the requested coconut cups with straws and hibiscus detail.

category.why: Features a stylized surface and single-color gradient background with subtle rings.

clean.why: Free of text, UI elements, borders, and characters.

framing.why: The composition is crowded, with the left straw nearly touching the canvas edge.

colour.why: Vibrant and saturated palette with good subject-background contrast.

detail.why: Fine striations and grooves are visible on the coconut shells.

style.why: Smooth 3D volumes with satin sheen matching the reference aesthetic.

fix: Scale down the cups slightly to improve margins and remove the fine fibrous grooves from the shells.
